items.title: Lock Rio test shoots with the model agencies
items.text: Work Agency and Base Management both replied. To get models booked in Rio, I need to send them {{how many models, what profile, and which days}}.
items.note: Two reply drafts are waiting in Approvals. Agencies move on fast if they don't hear back.

items.title: Get the Noctis publication
items.text: Noctis will decide on publishing the shoot once they see {{the final images}}.
items.note: Genea Bailey asked for finals. The reply promising them is in Approvals; the real work is picking and exporting the frames.

items.title: Start the dating photo app demand test
items.text: The dating photo app test is ready and waits on one thing from me: {{approving the $3/day Meta campaign}}.
items.note: Four 'launching soon' pages on dating-photos-ai, one ad each. Nothing spends until you approve. The card expires 11 November.

items.title: Pick one accountability app idea to test
items.text: The accountability app is still only ideas. The next move is to {{pick one idea and put up a 'launching soon' page for it}}, like the dating pages.
items.note: Your own rule: no building from a guess. Candidates already researched: commitment-based work sessions ($9/month) and task-start support ($12/month).

items.title: Lock the São Paulo week
items.text: My São Paulo dates are {{24 to 30 November}}, and Mafê Domingues is waiting on my reply about date, budget and publication.
items.note: The reply draft is in Approvals and expires 12 November.

items.title: Send the Purple pitch
items.text: The Purple pitch is drafted. It closes by saying I have {{a stylist and a pull letter}} ready.
items.note: A magazine pitch only counts once it is sent. Check the stylist line is still true, then send.

items.title: Clear usage rights for the dating ad photos
items.text: Before the dating ads run, I must confirm I have {{usage rights for the 4 portfolio frames}} of models used in them.
items.note: Frames: r1-05457-0036, 000067-4, 000049660026, manila-gallery-floor-001. Swap any you can't clear.

items.title: Decide the Rio hotels and venues outreach
items.text: One approval sends my shoot pitch to {{85 hotels, restaurants and venues}} in Rio, starting with Grupo Arpoador.
items.note: Locations and hospitality clients in one move. Read the sample email first; nothing sends until you approve.

items.title: Start posting the planned Instagram grid
items.text: My Instagram grid plan is saved at /picks: {{126 picks, portraits interleaved with documentary}}. The plan earns nothing until I start posting it.
items.note: Agencies and magazines check the grid before they answer a pitch.

items.title: Answer Giovanna
items.text: Giovanna asked about date, location, role and budget. The one thing only I can answer is {{how I found her}}.
items.note: The reply draft is in Approvals with that part left open for you.

items.title: Lock Rio test shoots with the model agencies
items.text: {{Base Management}} asked three things: is it TFP, how many models, and which dates.
items.note: Answer all three in one reply so they can send options straight away.

items.title: Get the Noctis publication
items.text: The first step toward the Noctis publication is to {{open the shoot folder and star the frames I would send}}.
items.note: Aim for a tight edit. A magazine judges the weakest frame.

items.title: Start the dating photo app demand test
items.text: The dating test puts four ideas against each other: AI shoot, camera-roll edit, profile audit and {{swipe test}}.
items.note: Each ad goes to its own email page, so sign-ups tell you which idea people want.

items.title: Pick one accountability app idea to test
items.text: My rule for building any app: build after {{1 pre-order, 3 'I'd pay' clicks, or 10 sign-ups in 72 hours}}.
items.note: So the accountability app needs a page that can collect those before any code.

items.title: Lock the São Paulo week
items.text: To Mafê I describe the shoot as {{pitched to international magazines}}, so the magazine line has to be one I can stand behind.
items.note: Check which magazines the draft names before approving.

items.title: Send the Purple pitch
items.text: The pitch to {{Purple}} is written but unsent. Sending it is a ten-minute job.
items.note: Drafted in the 'Rio de Janeiro fashion editorial critique' session.

items.title: Clear usage rights for the dating ad photos
items.text: The dating ads use my portfolio photos of {{real models}}, which is why rights have to be cleared before they go live.
items.note: A model seeing her face on a dating ad without consent is the fastest way to lose an agency.

items.title: Decide the Rio hotels and venues outreach
items.text: The venue emails go out within {{450 a day, in office hours}}, and only after I approve the category.
items.note: The card expires 16 November.

items.title: Start posting the planned Instagram grid
items.text: The first step on the Instagram grid is to {{post the first three picks from /picks today}}.
items.note: Three posts make one finished row.

items.title: Lock Rio test shoots with the model agencies
items.text: Model agencies are first in my outreach send order because {{tests with agency models are what get me published and booked}}.
items.note: Your send order: replies, model agencies, follow-ups, then the rest.

items.title: Start the dating photo app demand test
items.text: Over 14 days the dating test costs about {{$42}}, which buys the answer to 'which idea do I build'.
items.note: It has no end date, so set a reminder to read the numbers and stop it.

items.title: Pick one accountability app idea to test
items.text: I kill an app idea after {{7 days under 3 sign-ups}}, so the accountability idea needs a start date to be judged against.
items.note: Pick the idea today and the clock can start this week.

items.title: Get the Noctis publication
items.text: My contact at Noctis is {{Genea Bailey}}.
items.note: Send the finals to her directly once the reply has gone out.
